0.0: What's a human doing here? I have nothing to talk to you about. Please leave.\r\n#L0##bI don't think I want to talk to you, either!#l\r\n#L1#About the 'Flying Pill'...#k#l
0.1: Hey, how can a human like you know of such a medicine? Well, even if you know of it, I don't think I feel like talking about it to someone like you! \r\n#L0##bYou are one rude, despicable kid!#l\r\n#L1#I really need that pill, though.#l#k
0.2:
What?! A kid? Trust me, I am NOT a kid! !
#L0##bSorry, didn't mean to be rude#l
#L1#Aren't you much too young to talk to me like that anyway?#l
#L2#I wouldn't even be here if not for Icarus...#k#l
0.3: Icarus? You're here for him? He's the only friend of mine that is human... and since you're here at his request, I'll make you the pill. You'll need to know that the ingredients I need are really hard to find. I wonder if you are qualified enough to gather them all up.

1.1: Whether you need it or not, that's your business, not mine.

2.0: Get out of my face. Bye!
2.1: Hey, you're talking to a fairy! Of course I've lived much longer than you! In any case, I don't feel like talking to you, so just leave!

yes.0:
Okay. You seem like the kind of person that really cares about keeping promises. You're not as bad as I thought... Get me #b50 #t4000207#s#k and #b20 Witchgrass Leaves#k, and I'll make you the #b#t4031163##k. The Witchgrass Leaves grow in swamps, and they're not the easiest to extract. You absolutely have to #bextract from the right side#k in order to do it correctly. Good luck...


You can get the #b#t4000207# by defeating monsters at the #rClosed Area at the Excavation Site#k.

no.0: I knew you'd be like this. It's way too tough for a weakling like you. At least you're aware of your limitations. Now get out of here!

1.0: Whoa you got them all? What's this? The leaves are dry! How am I going to make the Flying Pill with crappy ingredients like this? \r\n#L0##bHey, what's your problem??#l\r\n#L1#They look fine to me.#k#l
1.1: What are you trying to say? You don't even know what you're talking about! I'll use these ingredients for now, but it's not my responsibility if it comes out less than perfect. The ingredients you got me stink!

0.0: What? I don't feel like making it right now. Come back some other time.

item.0: Were you even listening to what I said? I need #b50 #t4000207#s#k and #b20 Witchgrass Leaves#k! Got it?
